title: Implement API service accounts, OAuth2 and rate limits

environment.profile: local acceptance on Darwin arm64; synthetic fixtures only

BIO-INT-003-AC01.finding: Service-account persistence and every lookup/mutation are explicitly tenant-scoped with cross-tenant isolation tests.

BIO-INT-003-AC02.finding: Client-credentials tokens use a closed ten-role scope vocabulary that excludes SuperAdmin; effective scopes are intersected with live account state and mapped through real tenant-scoped BIO-IDN-006 role-permission grants.

BIO-INT-003-AC03.finding: Tenant/client/route fixed-window limits return audited 429 responses with Retry-After, and token/account security events are auditable.

BIO-INT-003-AC04.finding: Secrets are cryptographically random, stored only as peppered hashes, returned once, rotatable and absent from audit payloads; token and hash keys fail closed when missing or weak.

BIO-INT-003-AC05.finding: The API Credentials panel is additively mounted beside BIO-INT-002's ImportConsole and uses four independently switchable IntegrationService ports for account lifecycle operations.

commands.result: UNAVAILABLE in acceptance sandbox: compilation stalled without output and was stopped; exact-commit builder and reviewer evidence records a clean build

open_follow_up_obligations.trigger: A supported production-real BIO-IDN-006 grant-seeding fixture becomes available
open_follow_up_obligations.required_action: Replace the unit-only positive permission-mapping proof with a real-HTTP ordinary-role allow test that seeds a genuine tenant RolePermissionGrant without using SuperAdmin or internal test-only shortcuts.
open_follow_up_obligations.current_evidence: Service-level tests cover allow/deny/revoke/cross-tenant mapping; the real host proves default deny and rejects SuperAdmin account creation.

final_acceptance.reason: All five acceptance criteria map to exact-commit implementation, focused structural tests, builder evidence and independent QA/security PASS reviews. Fresh structural, traceability, module-direction and secret checks pass. The missing real-HTTP ordinary-grant allow fixture is explicitly preserved as a non-blocking evidence follow-up without reintroducing the prohibited SuperAdmin shortcut.
